• A computer program is a sequence of text instructions that can be
“understood" by a computer and executed
• A programming language is a machine-readable artificial language
designed to express computations that can be performed by a computer

Machine code (language)
•

Computers understand only machine language
•

Basically, looks like a sequence of 1’s and 0’s

•

Very inconvenient to work with and non-intuitive

•

All other computer languages were created for human convenience (“highlevel”)

•

The computer does not understand C/Python/Java - They must be “translated”
into machine language

•

Other courses will teach you how hardware and software work.

ASCII table
The ASCII table (American Standard Code for Information
Interchange) is a character encoding standard that represents
text in computers and other devices that handle text.

ASCII assigns a unique number (code) to each character,
which allows computers to understand and display letters,
numbers, punctuation marks, and control characters
consistently across different platforms.

Why do we need different types?
• In java, like other statically typed languages (C, C++, C#), data
types are essential for:
• Type safety - Java prevents you from performing illogical or invalid operations.
• Efficiency and Performance - When the compiler knows each variable’s type, it
can allocate the exact amount of memory needed and optimize the code.

• Error Detection at Compile Time - Because Java is statically typed, many errors
are caught during compilation rather than at runtime — saving debugging time
later.

Flow control
Should a program always execute line after line?
Different inputs >> different execution.
– For example: a user enters password, what
to do if it’s right? if it’s wrong?
Structures that alter code linearity are – conditional statements
– loops
– functions

Indentation:
• Following the if statement:
